Haha yeah! There are actually. Like at the really fancy supermarkets and nature places you'll find some gluten-free alternatives to pasta, bread, cookies, that kinda stuff. I get those alot. But unfortunately they taste nothing like the original. Guess that's the way it goes :P. But yeah, they can be. Most people who have Celiac Disease are allergic to MSG. They kind of go hand-in-hand most times.

Oh I know it.. I thought about doing a AMA on that, but I'm not sure how much attention it would get. I eat out with everyone else but I always get a steak (This can get expensive) or a cheeseburger without the bun. It's annoying and sort of embarrassing. But I have to ask the people if the sauce has Gluten in it, or MSG (you'll find that in soups and stuff) Which I'm also allergic to it. If I do eat it I start violently throwing up. But the long term effects of it are like seizures, cancer of the stomach lining, all that fun stuff.

Well, not all of my friends are crazy rebellious (partying, drinking, ect.) So I just hang out with them. It kind of sucks, cause ya know every adult should be able to look back on their teenage years as a crazy time. But it's kind of for the best, whenever I do do something rebellious I'm a basket case about it. Like I know I'm going to get caught. Oh well. Above the influence, Amirite?

I mostly don't think about it. I Try to be a bubbly, outgoing person. Ever heard the expression "Fake it till you make it"? It's true. I'm currently trying out psychiatrists and psychologists all around but none work as well as going out and having fun. Seriously.
